title.narrative: Improving Performance Accountability by Strengthening DR SAI

description.narrative: The proposed IDF will strengthen the SAI role of performing audits to public entities according to the guidelines defined by the InternationalAuditing and Assurance Standards Board (IAASB) of the International Federation of Accountants (IFAC). Improve the info The objective of this proposal is to improve accountability for public sector performance in the DR by strengthening the institutional capacity of the Chamber of Accounts as DR Supreme Audit Institution (SAI) to conduct its auditing role as mandated by the Constitution and the Law. Overall, the project will contribute to strengthening the Chamber of Accounts auditing role by improving its capacity to perform external audits within the new public expenditure framework - enhancing the transparency and accountability of the public entities. In turn, this will improve the public's trust in this oversight body and enhance communication between the Chamber of Accounts, the Congress, and the public in general.
